title: Isolated hypnotic regressions of the four Allagash witnesses

tellings.quote: we all four of us agreed to undergo um

plain: Jim Weiner, one of four men in a case known as the Allagash abductions, in which they say beings took them during a camping trip dated to 1976, says all four agreed to undergo hypnotic regression, hypnosis meant to bring back buried memories, each one kept apart from the others, in Massachusetts. He tells Michels the sessions were run by the researcher Raymond Fowler, who wrote them up in the book The Allagash Abductions; the point of keeping them apart is that matching stories would be hard to explain as shared invention.
